source_policy: 两怒海原狂暴攻击等同愤怒攻击，甄乾坤低HP增强/30%以下或血魔最大保留。概率/增幅/曲线/动作取样时点为项目采用，不冒充官网完整公式。

one_attack_enrage_equivalent.requires_root: normal or attack martial, learned allocated positive effective skill; no healing/gather/derived/status burst
one_attack_enrage_equivalent.draw_time: accepted valid paid attack, once per action, before attack-interval snapshot. Failed admission no draw; miss after accepted cast still consumes result/cost.
one_attack_enrage_equivalent.attack_effect: own action ordinary attack anchor gets highest of current real enrage attack multiplier and natural-enrage-equivalent12000bp, never multiply both oradd another20percent
one_attack_enrage_equivalent.scope: one accepted root including its same snapshot derived hits; do not redraw per hit/target; descendants cannot proc new berserk
one_attack_enrage_equivalent.already_enraged: action attack multiplier no extra benefit; no fake new source/extended timer, avoid pointless chance draw when current real rage factor already>=12000
one_attack_enrage_equivalent.fixed_legacy_damage_profile: no attack interval component -> no contribution or pointless roll; not converted to extra fixed-power percent

low_hp_attack.eligible: Zhen root normal/attack martial, learned allocated positive grade; actual casteralive valid0<HP<=maxHP
low_hp_attack.snapshot_time: after normal/HPcost and blood-devil0cost override committed, before attack-interval snapshot; no repeated cost or damage-as-cost callback
low_hp_attack.maximum_curve: when HP*10<=maxHP*3 OR active blood-devil challenge, gain=100*grade; otherwise floor(100*grade*(maxHP-HP)*10/(maxHP*7))
low_hp_attack.attack_source: apply to ordinary attack interval both endpoints once, before rage/weakening downstream stages, not to skill flat power or entire final damage
low_hp_attack.blood_devil: max curve only, still its separate declared direct damage20percent once; do not multiply max-curve again from enrage label
low_hp_attack.later_heal_or_anti: old accepted snapshot fixed; new actions recalculate, no persistent bonus cache

common: all coefficients/sums checked exact; grade0 contribution0, temporary passive reduction does not erase allocated points. No separate crit/instant kill/HP drain/protection. Source action snapshot records root grade/HP cost/result and multiplier, save/replay no second roll.
scope: Han天魔狂血/极血/之力 and dependent passives remain unadopted; these named equivalent attacks do not substitute those independently sourced mechanics.
